name: Stratholme (Classic)
summary: Scourge and Scarlet Crusade forces fight through Stratholme's burning ruins. Once northern Lordaeron's jewel and the birthplace of the Silver Hand, the city now lies divided between them.

sections.title: The Cursed Capital
sections.body:
Stratholme once held great power in northern Lordaeron and gave birth to the Knights of the Silver Hand. During the Third War, Prince Arthas purged the city after infected grain carried plague through its gates. He slaughtered his own subjects. The city smoldered in ruins, then the Scourge claimed it.

Kel'Thuzad holds overarching authority, while Baron Rivendare commands the undead forces in the field. From Stratholme, they direct Scourge power across the Plaguelands.

sections.title: A Divided Warfront
sections.body:
Two vicious factions wage an unending war through Stratholme. In the west, the fanatical Scarlet Crusade holds Crusaders' Square and the Scarlet Bastion under Grand Crusader Saidan Dathrohan. In the east, Scourge slaughterhouses and necropolises stand behind towering ziggurats. The death knight Baron Rivendare guards them.

Burning tenements and restless spirits surround anyone who enters. Across the city, both sides trade blows.

faq.answer: Prince Arthas set Stratholme ablaze during his purge in the Third War, hoping to stop the plague of undeath from spreading. Dark magic, necromancy, and the unending war between the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade keep the fires smoldering.

aliases: who is in charge of stratholme
faq.answer: Control is divided between the Scarlet Crusade in the west and the Scourge in the east. Grand Crusader Dathrohan leads the Crusaders from their western bastion. Baron Rivendare rules the eastern ruins for the Scourge under Kel'Thuzad.

faq.q: What is the historical significance of the city to paladins?
faq.answer: Stratholme gave birth to the Order of the Silver Hand. There, Archbishop Alonsus Faol first consecrated Uther the Lightbringer and the original paladins. The city's fall marks the deepest tragedy in the order's history.

faq.q: How do you enter the Scourge-controlled side of the city?
aliases: how to get into undead side
faq.answer: You can fight through the main gate to reach the eastern Scourge district, or enter directly through the Service Entrance. Magistrate Barthilas holds the key to that back gate. Skilled rogues, powerful blacksmith skeleton keys, or goblin explosives can breach it.

angles.text: As a paladin, Stratholme's desecration cuts deeply. It is the sacred birthplace of the Silver Hand and the graveyard where Arthas shattered Uther's guidance.
As an Alliance soldier or survivor, Stratholme recalls Lordaeron's catastrophic fall and the terrible cost of the Third War.
